entries.name: Handoff
entries.summary: `/handoff <goal>` turns the useful parts of the current conversation into an editable prompt, then opens a fresh session and links it to the current session when persistence is enabled.
compatibility: Selected model available through Pi's model runtime

entries.name: Explanatory output style
entries.summary: Adds explanatory guidance before each agent run so implementation work includes short, code-specific learning notes.

entries.name: Mac system theme
entries.summary: Keeps interactive Pi sessions aligned with macOS light or dark appearance.
entries.limitation: macOS-only; AppleScript failures fall back to light, and appearance is polled every two seconds.

entries.name: Notify
entries.summary: Sends a fixed ‘ready for input’ notification through Windows, Kitty, or OSC-compatible terminal protocols.
entries.limitation: Terminal support is heuristic, notification failures are not surfaced, and this local copy triggers on `agent_end`.

entries.name: Status line
entries.summary: Shows ready, running, and completed turn states in Pi’s themed footer.
entries.limitation: Display state is process-local, uses a fixed status key, and is a compact activity indicator rather than durable telemetry.
compatibility: Interactive Pi status and theme APIs

entries.name: Pi Subagents
entries.summary: Adds controlled subagent delegation, scripted multi-agent workflows, background execution, and recovery surfaces to Pi.

entries.name: Visual Explainer
entries.summary: Adds a sequential prepare-and-render tool that guides visual explanation planning, validates complete HTML documents, and writes them inside a fixed diagrams directory.

entries.name: Pi Watcher
entries.summary: `AI!` and `AI?` trigger focused Pi follow-up turns from editor comments; `AI.` supplies context without triggering a turn.

entries.name: Pi Ralph Loop
entries.summary: Runs a plan from durable plan/progress files one task per iteration, with feedback, commits, context collapse, and explicit completion.
compatibility: Pi session navigation and compaction APIs

entries.name: Tufte visualization
entries.summary: Applies Tufte-inspired checks to design or critique clear, dense, honest data visualizations.

entries.name: Sharpen communication
entries.summary: Reworks supplied communication around its main point, audience, intent, and desired outcome.

entries.name: Pi AskUserQuestion
entries.summary: Adds a model-invoked question tool that collects one to four structured choices or free-text answers in Pi's interactive terminal UI.
entries.limitation: Requires an interactive Pi session; duplicate questions or option labels are rejected, and the tool disables itself when no UI is available.

entries.name: Pi Better OpenAI
entries.summary: Adds OpenAI fast-mode request tiering, subscription usage feedback, footer controls, Codex image generation, and local pet rendering to Pi.
entries.limitation: Fast mode applies only to configured models; usage and image features require OpenAI Codex OAuth, and rendered pets need compatible terminal image support.
compatibility: Pi extension hooks, tools, and footer APIs
OpenAI Codex OAuth for usage and image features
Optional terminal image support for rendered pets

entries.name: Pi Boomerang
entries.summary: Runs autonomous Pi tasks, then replaces their retained conversational detail with a generated session-tree summary while leaving workspace changes in place.
entries.limitation: Its summary is heuristic, it does not sandbox task execution or restore files, and the reviewed fork declares no source license; this guide supplies factual prose and links only.
compatibility: Pi extension, command, tool, and session-tree APIs
Pi prompt templates for template and chain execution
Available Pi models and skills when selected by template frontmatter

entries.name: LLM Wiki Capture
entries.summary: Packages explicitly requested conversation knowledge into durable source material, sends it through `denote llm-wiki ingest`, and reports the resulting wiki changes.
entries.limitation: Capture persists material on disk and requires a configured Denote LLM Wiki environment; sensitive content needs review before ingestion.
compatibility: denote CLI with LLM Wiki configuration

entries.name: Caveman
entries.summary: Adds selectable terse-response modes to Pi while preserving technical details and restoring explicit prose when safety or clarity requires it.
compatibility: Writable user config directory for saved defaults

entries.name: Chrome CDP
entries.summary: After explicit user approval, guides an agent to inspect, debug, or interact with an existing local Chrome-family tab through a lightweight CDP CLI.
entries.limitation: Never use without explicit user approval; browser access can expose authenticated page state, and Chrome's Allow debugging prompt is an additional gate rather than consent for the agent task.
compatibility: Chrome-family browser with remote debugging enabled

entries.name: ADR
entries.summary: Guides creation and maintenance of architecture decision records, with a bundled Bun CLI for deterministic filenames, links, reports, and validation.
entries.limitation: Helper commands require Bun, and the pinned repository declares no public source license; this catalog supplies factual notes and links only.

entries.name: Pi BTW
entries.summary: Runs bounded side questions in isolated read-only child sessions while the main workflow stays focused.
compatibility: Selected model through Pi's provider runtime

entries.name: Pi Exa
entries.summary: Adds source-oriented web search and bounded content retrieval through Exa.

entries.name: Pi Prompt History
entries.summary: Indexes prior user prompts locally for scoped search, reuse, and session resumption.
compatibility: Bun SQLite or supported Node.js SQLite runtime

entries.name: Pi Quiz Me
entries.summary: Builds and grades an interactive quiz from the current Pi session branch.
compatibility: Selected model through Pi's model registry

entries.name: Pi Review Code
entries.summary: Builds context-rich review prompts, records findings, and launches focused fix follow-ups.
compatibility: Optional GitHub or GitLab command-line client

entries.name: Pi Simplify Code
entries.summary: Follows eligible code-changing turns with a changed-path-aware request for behavior-preserving simplification, with automatic, disabled, confirm-first, and manual modes.
compatibility: Git or Jujutsu for full working-copy discovery

entries.name: Pi Read Map
entries.summary: Adds bounded structural maps to large read results, with language-specific symbol extraction, fallbacks, caching, and line ranges for targeted follow-up reads.
compatibility: Bundled parsers with optional system-tool fallbacks

entries.name: Pi Interactive Shell
entries.summary: Runs interactive terminal programs in observable overlays or managed background sessions, with direct control, dispatch completion, and event-driven monitoring.

entries.name: Pi Intercom
entries.summary: Routes targeted messages, questions, replies, attachments, and presence between connected Pi sessions through a same-machine broker, with explicit transcript and inbound-trigger boundaries.
